context.text: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

primaryTextChecks.text: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

context.text: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them. Jephthah spoke all his words before the LORD in Mizpah.
Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, “What do you have to do with me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?”

The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”
After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.
Manoah arose and followed his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” He said, “I am.”
Manoah said, “Now let your words happen. What shall the child’s way of life and mission be?”
The LORD’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.

wikipediaRead.locator: Article body lines 131–133 and 166–170; distinguishes valley and city, cites Judges 1:34–35, and gives Yalo as an identification.
wikipediaRead.supportingParaphraseJa: 記事の導入と「Tribe of Dan」節は谷とアヤロンの町を区別し、士師記1:34–35でアモリ人が町に住んだこと、ヤロを古代町の候補とする説明を載せる。谷全体と町の一点は同一ではない。

reuseCheck.detail: The Ayalon Valley article was linked for JOS Aijalon; reread current body supports Judges 1:35 specifically but does not justify joining the Zebulun Aijalon at 12:12.

readerFieldRecheck.reasonJa: 地図注記で後出12:12の同名地を挙げる必要はなく、初出1:35より後の同名情報の先取りを除く。町/谷の対象差は他欄に残す。
